summary: Comprehensive backend + mobile UI testing for Mystic XP (Duolingo-style tarot app). 19/19 pytest backend tests pass covering auth, cards, lessons, quizzes (auth-gated, correct_index omitted, submission with XP/streak/level/hearts persistence), refill-hearts and progress aggregation. Frontend mobile UI (390x844) E2E: welcome → signup → home with stats header + level bar + 10 lesson path nodes (only first unlocked, others locked with dashed connectors), lesson screen with 5-step progression (intro + 4 sections + Start Quiz CTA), quiz with 3 questions and quiz-result screen, return-to-home keeps lesson as Current when not passed (1/3 correct, expected behaviour), Library tab shows all 10 Major Arcana tiles, Progress tab shows Level/XP/Streak/Hearts/Lessons/Mastery%, Profile tab shows user info + Level badge and Sign Out logout that returns to welcome. No backend errors, no React Native red screen, no deprecated package usage detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings observed: 'shadow*' style props deprecated -> use 'boxShadow' (RN web compat warning, low priority); props.pointerEvents deprecated -> use style.pointerEvents (low priority). Not blocking.
Initial /api/auth/me returns 401 when no token stored yet (expected — AuthProvider tries refresh on cold start). Not an issue but noisy in console.
Quiz options are generated by sorting alphabetically (server-side) — option ordering is deterministic but predictable; acceptable for an MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (signup, home path, lesson, quiz, result, tabs Library/Progress/Profile, logout)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 10 Major Arcana cards + 10 lessons + 10 quizzes on first startup (verified). Test users created via /api/auth/signup with prefix 'test_*@mystic.app' for cleanup; UI tests use 'tabs_*' / 'e2e_*' / 'flow_*' / 'ui_*' prefixes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_mystic_tarot.py runs in ~2s and covers everything. Library card tiles use testID 'card-{index}' (not 'card-tile-*'); card detail uses 'toggle-upright'/'toggle-reversed'; profile logout uses 'logout-btn'. Lesson progression button: 'lesson-next-btn' (text Continue → Start Quiz on last step). Quiz uses 'quiz-option-{i}' and 'quiz-continue-btn' then 'quiz-done-btn' on result. Note: picking option 0 for every quiz answer yields 1/3 (not passing); to test pass flow use correct keyword/name mapping (see test_submit_quiz_all_correct).
